on_screen_text.text:
Reply to Mary Schnitzer Hochron's comment
Do Something!! 💙
Save us from 47
Rep. Ivey on what Democrats are doing to stop Trump's agenda

WE GOT THE MESSAGE FROM THE ELECTION WORRIED ABOUT, KEEPING A ROOF OVER THEIR HEAD, PUTTING FOOD ON THE TABLE, GAS IN THE CAR, KEEPING THEIR JOBS AND THE LIKE. THIS GUY'S COME IN, HE'S DONE ALL THIS STUFF THAT GOES IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION. FOR EXAMPLE, FIRING GOVERNMENT WORKERS. NOW I'VE GOT A LOT IN MY DISTRICT, BUT 80% OF GOVERNMENT WORKERS LIVE OUTSIDE THE WASHINGTON METROPOLITAN AREA. THEY DO GREAT WORK. THEY'VE GOT THE EXPERIENCE AND EXPERTISE TO DO THE WORK TO HELP PEOPLE WITH THE THINGS THAT THEY NEED TO GET DONE. HE'S GOING AGAINST THAT. HE'S TRYING TO ELIMINATE THEM AND REPLACE THEM WITH HIS POLITICAL CRONIES. ANOTHER ONE THAT WE WERE ABLE TO BLOCK SUCCESSFULLY. HE WAS GOING TO CUT ALL THE FUNDING FOR, LIKE, EVERYTHING. MEALS ON WHEELS, CANCER RESEARCH, ALL KINDS OF ASSISTANCE FOR TEACHERS IN TITLE 1 SCHOOLS. YOU NAME IT, HE WAS GOING TO CUT THE FUNDING FOR IT. THE PUSHBACK WAS STRONG ENOUGH TO MAKE HIM RECONSIDER. AND WE'VE ALSO BEEN EFFECTIVE IN COURT WORKING WITH SOME OF THE UNIONS AND ADVOCACY GROUPS WHO'VE DONE A GOOD JOB THERE. WE GOT TO FIGHT IT OFF ON ALL FRONTS AND MAKE SURE WE USE EVERYTHING WE CAN. WE NEED ALL HANDS ON DECK TO WIN THIS BATTLE AND WE'RE GOING TO BE ABLE TO MOVE FORWARD AND TAKE THE HOUSE BACK IN TWO YEARS AND MAKE HAKEEM JEFFRIES THE NEXT SPEAKER OF THE HOUSE.

spoken_summary: Rep. Glenn Ivey addresses a commenter's concern, stating that Democrats understand voters' economic worries about housing, food, and jobs. He claims Donald Trump's agenda is harmful, citing plans to fire government workers and replace them with 'political cronies' and cut funding for social programs like Meals on Wheels and cancer research. Ivey says Democrats have successfully blocked these efforts through public pressure and legal action with unions. He calls for an 'all hands on deck' fight to win back the House in two years and make Hakeem Jeffries the Speaker.
audio_music: The audio consists of a single person's speech, with ambient background noise of a busy hall or conference center. There is no music or added sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static talking-head shot. The primary editing consists of added on-screen text, including a main caption, a reply-to-comment box, and dynamic subtitles that highlight the speaker's words as he says them.
central_claim: Democrats are actively and successfully fighting against Donald Trump's agenda, which they characterize as harmful to American workers and social programs.
intended_effect: To reassure Democratic voters that the party is effectively opposing Donald Trump and to motivate them for future elections.
